title: An element of the maximal ideal outside the minimal primes of the support cuts the support dimension by exactly one
statement: Let $(R,\mathfrak m)$ be a Noetherian local ring [def-weil-pbc-noetherian-ring] (a Noetherian commutative ring with exactly one maximal ideal $\mathfrak m$). For a finite $R$-module $N$ let $\operatorname{Supp}(N)$ be the set of prime ideals $\mathfrak p\subset R$ with $N_{\mathfrak p}\neq0$, $N_{\mathfrak p}$ the localization [def-weil-pbc-module-localization], and let $\dim\operatorname{Supp}(N)\in\{-\infty,0,1,2,\dots\}$ be the supremum of the integers $n\ge0$ for which there is a chain $\mathfrak p_0\subsetneq\cdots\subsetneq\mathfrak p_n$ of prime ideals all lying in $\operatorname{Supp}(N)$ ($-\infty$ when $N=0$; $-\infty+1=-\infty$). Let $M$ be a finite $R$-module [def-weil-finitely-generated-module], $\operatorname{Ann}_R(M)=\{a\in R: aM=0\}$ its annihilator, and $f\in\mathfrak m$. Suppose that (1) $f$ lies in no prime ideal of $R$ that is minimal among the prime ideals containing $\operatorname{Ann}_R(M)$, or (2) $f$ is a nonzerodivisor on $M$ (multiplication by $f$ on $M$ is injective). Then $\dim\operatorname{Supp}(M/fM)+1=\dim\operatorname{Supp}(M)$.
